name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2132: Stopping the OS grey box opening over the rich item card meant borrowing the anchor title, which was right and had a cost nobody had paid. On the mouse path that sentence then went nowhere, and measured on the live board, 987 of 5010 art anchors carry both attributes, so for those the hint they were written to carry became invisible the moment the card claimed the hover. It is rendered as the cards own footer now, the same treatment the console tooltip already uses, and cleared whenever there is nothing to say so the last cards sentence cannot ride onto an item that has no title.
